Notes on how I wrote these from the page alone:
- Strings have no `trim`, so I split on spaces, drop the empty pieces and join back.
- Numbers don't come out of strings, so I use `parseJson`.
- Where two conditions had to hold, I chained `filter`s instead of passing two modifiers to `and`.
- `round` is used with no argument, so L1 and L6 scale by 100 or 10 and divide back.
- `groupBy` and `indexBy` with a key quote are guesses, since the page only shows `groupBy` bare.

L1: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") * /items | flat * (mul /qty (at :price | coalesce 0)) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
L2: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (at :labels | coalesce []) | flat | groupBy * count
L3: [/dependencies /devDependencies] * (filter ~(startsWith "^0.") | keys) | flat | distinct | sort * keyword
L4: /data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | ne null) * (/email | lower) | distinct | sort
L5: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | coalesce true | eq true) | filter ~(at :port | ne null) | :s / | keys * (:k / | s | at k | {:name (k | keyword) :port /port}) | sort ~/port
L6: lines | filter ~(split " " | [(at 1 | eq "GET") (at 3 | eq "200")] | every ~/) * (split " " | /4 | take (count | sub 2) | parseJson) | :d / | sum | div (d | count) | mul 10 | round | div 10
L7: lines | drop 1 * split "," | filter ~(at 2 | coalesce "" | ne "") | groupBy ~(/1 | lower) * (/ * (/2 | parseJson) | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | round)
L8: groupBy ~/user * count | :g / | keys * (:k / | {:u (k | keyword) :c (g | at k)}) | sort ~([(/c | mul -1) /u]) | take 3 * ([/u (/c | print)] | join ":")
L9: "Apple, banana, apple , Cherry, banana, apple, date" | split "," * (split " " | filter ~(count | gt 0) | join "" | lower) | distinct | sort | join "|"
L10: lines * (split " " | filter ~(count | gt 0) | join "") | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(contains "==") * {:n (split "==" | /0 | lower) :v (split "==" | /1)} | indexBy ~/n * /v
L11: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | eq null) | sort ~([(/comments | mul -1) /number]) | take 2 * /number
L12: groupBy ~/customer | filter ~(count | gt 1) | keys * keyword | sort
L13: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :address | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") * (/ * /name | sort)
L14: filter ~(/type | eq "push") | filter ~(at :payload | coalesce {} | at :repo | coalesce {} | at :name | ne null) * /payload/repo/name | distinct | sort
